# Benjamin Poon (潘国雄), Service Advisor and Life Managing Director, Singapore

> Benjamin Poon (潘国雄) is a Service Advisor and Life Managing Director (生命经理师) in Singapore who represents Nirvana Singapore (富贵山庄). He helps families with columbarium niches (福位/骨灰位), ancestral tablets (神主牌), funeral arrangements (殡葬服务) and will planning (遗嘱规划, with Advance Planners). Venues: Nirvana Memorial Garden, 950 Old Choa Chu Kang Road, Singapore 699816; Lin San Temple (灵山寺), 27 Lorong 12 Geylang, Singapore 399004; Thian Leng Chong Toh Tong (天灵总道堂), 472 Changi Road, Singapore 419890. He is named in the APG (Advance Planners) September 2025 Award, October 2025 Sales Award and May 2026 Sales Award. Languages: English and Chinese. WhatsApp or call +65 8932 9933, email benpoon.nirvana@gmail.com. This is his personal website, not the official website of Nirvana (nirvana.com.sg) or any temple. Prices and availability are given by Benjamin on request from the operators; none are published here.
